claims.title: Normalized differential-polynomial Mittag-Leffler expansion
claims.scope: All fixed complex-coefficient polynomials; normal convergence off the nonpositive integers. Scalar powers are prior work.

claims.title: Scalar projection and complete Stieltjes correction
claims.scope: All fixed differential polynomials; exact residue pole classification and the original-coordinate finite part.

claims.title: Individually convergent spectral-word reduction
claims.scope: Every mixed monomial with K factors has a construction of depth at most K-1; no arithmetic minimality claim.

claims.title: Every bilinear polygamma finite part
claims.scope: Nonnegative r,s with r+s at least one. An explicit check and specialization; historical priority is not asserted.

claims.title: Canonical formal integration-by-parts complement
claims.scope: Formal dimension p(w)-p(w-1) at w>=2, with the finite endpoint map retained; not numerical independence.

claims.title: Normalized primitives and common-shift endpoint law
claims.scope: Slit-plane primitive and right-half-plane kernels. The full arithmetic shifted-coordinate classification remains open.

claims.title: One singular Laurent coordinate at every Gamma-Appell degree
claims.scope: All m>=2; mixed corrections are convergent first derivatives with depth at most m-3. Convergent coordinates are not eliminated arithmetically.

claims.title: Explicit sixth and seventh Gamma-Appell moments
claims.scope: Explicit derivative coordinate families, ordinary constants, normalized integrands, and self-contained recovery of raw powers.

claims.title: All odd-lattice order and depth jets
claims.scope: Every nonnegative derivative order and Re rho>0. Resolves Continuous Depth Q8 in the requested reflected-jet form.

claims.title: Normally convergent Euler evaluator for all reflected jets
claims.scope: All complex spectral orders and Re rho>0. Euler transformation itself is classical; joint continuation and differentiation are proved.

claims.title: Gamma-weighted polylogarithm order derivatives
claims.scope: Ordinary absolutely convergent integral with all fixed order and depth derivatives. Noninteger-depth arithmetic closure is not asserted.

claims.title: Stieltjes parameter transport
claims.scope: A classical consequence of the Hurwitz argument-derivative identity, included to fix conventions and evaluate depth two.

claims.title: Optimal initial moments for all adjacent even tail orders
claims.scope: Every p=q-2>=2. Formal coordinate rank q; general larger-gap nonvanishing remains open.

claims.title: Fixed-gap boundary determinant
claims.scope: Exact c-by-c reduction for gap 2c. No all-gap nonvanishing claim.

claims.title: Rational ordinary polygamma-product evaluations
claims.scope: Every adjacent pair gives an ordinary rational evaluation; the printed (4,6) case has an independent finite telescoping proof.

claims.title: Unrestricted unequal-order optimal prefix
claims.scope: The adjacent family is proved. General fixed-gap boundary nonvanishing is unresolved.

claims.title: Arithmetic elimination of convergent mixed coordinates
claims.scope: No assertion of independence, irreducibility, or a complete arithmetic basis.

claims.title: Gaussian S6 and revised S8
claims.scope: Their status is unchanged from the pinned manuscript; they are unrelated to the normalized digamma moment notation.
